# UD lamina property catalog (readable units: GPa, MPa, mm)
# Maintained by the CompositeLaminaLibrarian agent. SI twin: UD_lamina_catalog_SI.txt
# (generated from this file by lamina_catalog_to_SI.py; do not edit the SI file by hand).
#
# Columns: ID | Fiber | Polymer system | E1 | E2 | G12 | nu12 | nu23 | G23 | Xc | Xt | Yc | Yt | S12 | t_ply | Source
#   Xc/Xt = longitudinal compressive/tensile strength, Yc/Yt = transverse compressive/tensile strength,
#   S12 = in-plane shear strength. Strengths are positive magnitudes.
#   NA = not reported by the source.  * = estimate, not measured:
#     nu23* : matrix-dominated default (0.45 carbon/epoxy, 0.40 glass & basalt/epoxy, 0.45 flax)
#             or taken from the AS4/PEEK set L026 (0.49) for PEEK/PAEK rows.
#     G23*  : G23 = E2 / (2 (1 + nu23))  (transverse isotropy, same relation as PlyPropertyGenerator).
#     t*    : see per-ID note.
#   Conditions are room temperature dry/ambient, mean (not B-basis) values unless noted.
#   Unit conversions from US units: 1 ksi = 6.894757 MPa, 1 Msi = 6.894757 GPa, 1 in = 25.4 mm.
#
# Per-ID notes
#  L001 NCAMP CAM-RP-2009-015 Rev A Table 2-1, RTD mean. E1/Xt/Xc normalized to CPT 0.0072 in; Xc = UNC0 back-out; S12 at 5% strain (0.2% offset: 53.5 MPa). Vf ~59%.
#  L002 Camanho, Maimi & Davila 2007, Tables 1-2, 5-specimen means (ASTM D3039/D3410/D5379). Vf 59.1%. Unconstrained (not in-situ) strengths.
#  L003 NCAMP CAM-RP-2010-002 Rev A Table 2-1, RTD mean. Same conventions as L001. Vf ~59%.
#  L004 NCAMP CAM-RP-2013-002 Rev A Table 2-1, RTD mean; out-of-autoclave (VBO) cure. Vf ~59%.
#  L005 NCAMP CAM-RP-2010-048 / NCP-RP-2010-037. nu12 is the RTD compression value (RTD tension value invalid in report). S12 flagged by NCAMP as estimate (13 specimens). Vf ~56%.
#  L006 NCAMP CAM-RP-2008-007 Rev C, RTD mean; OOA cure. nu12 is the compression value (no tension nu12 reported). Xt, Xc back-outs.
#  L007 NCAMP NCP-RP-2008-004 Rev B Table 3-3, RTD mean (normalized E1/Xt/Xc). nu12 is the compression value. Yt very scattered.
#  L008 Toray 2510 datasheet, lot averages, RTA, oven cure, Vf 54.4%. S12 = D5379 ultimate (not 5% strain), so higher than other rows.
#  L009 FAA DOT/FAA/TC-19/50 Pt 2 (ASU, MAT213), 3-5 specimen averages. nu23 (=nu32, single specimen) and G23 measured; they do not satisfy G23 = E2/(2(1+nu23)) (would give 2.55). Xc (ASTM D3410) is suspiciously low. S12 = peak at ~13% strain. t* = 3.1 mm / 16 plies.
#  L010 Toray 3900 datasheet, P2362W-19L, RTA. nu12 not given. S12 at 5% strain. RTA E2 higher than CTD (as printed).
#  L011 Toray 3960 datasheet, P173EBN-19 Gr 192 autoclave, RTA. nu12 not given. Vf 57.9%.
#  L012 Toray 2511 datasheet, P211AS-200, RTA. nu12 not given. Vf 54.9%. Fiber assignment from datasheet layout (T800S, 200 gsm).
#  L013-L016 WWFE-I input data (Soden, Hinton & Kaddour 1998), read from NASA TM-107331 Table III ("Pristine" column), which reprints it. Vf 0.60 (L015: 0.62). nu23 = 0.4 as given; G23* from relation. Ply thickness not in reprint.
#  L016 G23 = 5.7 as tabulated in the WWFE-II input data for the same material (reprint: Zhang, Xu & Ye 2013, Table 2).
#  L017-L020 WWFE-II input data (Kaddour & Hinton 2012), read from Zhang, Xu & Ye 2013 (WWFE-II Part B) draft Table 2. Initial (linear) moduli; nu23, G23 as tabulated. Vf and ply thickness not given.
#  L018 CAUTION: G12 = 1.33 GPa is anomalously low and E2/G12 carry an unexplained footnote mark in the reprint; S12 differs between sources (97 / 76 / 60 MPa). Verify against the original before use.
#  L019, L020 resin not named in source ("Epoxy 1" / "Epoxy 2"). L020 Xt/Xc reported as 1410/1147 elsewhere.
#  L021 Amacher et al. 2014 via Frossard EPFL thesis Table 3.2; 30 g/m2 thin ply, normalized to Vf 55%. S12 = max shear stress (0.2% offset: 50.2 MPa).
#  L022 Liu, Bai et al. 2023 (arXiv Table 1), ASTM tests, resin not named. CAUTION: source G23 = 4.50 equals its G13 and is inconsistent with E2 (would need nu23 < 0); relation would give 2.59*. S12 = 216 MPa unusually high.
#  L023 Ning (Caltech thesis 2015) / Ning & Pellegrino IJSS 2017 measured stiffness, Vf ~50%; strengths not measured. G12 > E2 is unusual. Also used by Leclerc (Caltech thesis).
#  L024 Lenticular-boom CFRP of Liu et al. 2022 Table 2 (project Literature folder), citing Bai et al. 2019; fiber and Vf not given; E1 below normal carbon range. nu23* back-calculated from source G23 = 2.50.
#  L025 Sun & Yoon (Purdue CML 88-3, NASA) Table 1 (E1, E2, nu12, Xt, Yt, S12 via off-axis Tsai-Hill) and Sun & Rui (CML 89-2) Xc, Yc; 75 F dry. G12 not reported. t = 0.05 in / 10 plies.
#  L026 Zhang et al. 2022 Tables 2-3; compiled from APC-2 literature (not the authors' own tests). Vf 59%, nominal t 0.14 mm. nu23/G23 as tabulated (consistent with relation, likely computed).
#  L027 Fu et al. 2024 Table 2 (manufacturer-measured NIMTE prepreg). Yc and S12 left NA (paper borrows them from a different material). t from [0]8 = 1 mm.
#  L028 Toray Cetex TC1225 PDS v9, M55JB, RTA. Xc = back-out (D6641). S12 at 5% strain (0.2% offset: 42.2 MPa).
#  L029 Toray Cetex TC1200 PDS v4.0, AS4D, RTD, Vf 59% ("limited dataset"). nu12, Yc not given.
#  L030 Toray Cetex TC1225 PDS v9, T1100GC, RTA. S12 at 5% strain. nu12, Yc not given.
#  L031 Victrex LMPAEK UDT AS4-143-34 TDS (AE 250 family), RTA, Vf 58.1%. E2 is the 90 deg COMPRESSION modulus; no 90 deg tension (Yt NA). S12 per EN 6031.
#  L032 Victrex LMPAEK UDT AS7-192-34 TDS, RTA, Vf 58.5%, VBO panels. E2 = 90 deg compression modulus. S12 = 0.2% offset (D3518), not comparable to L031.
#  L033 Toray Cetex TC1100 PDS v6.1, AS4A/PPS, RTD, Vf 59%. nu12, Yc not given.
#  L034 Montana State Univ. (Samborsky, Mandell, Agastra; DOE/Sandia) Table 1, Vf 56.8%, infused stitched UD fabric. All values measured incl. nu23 and G23 (not consistent with relation, which gives 6.30). Tensile moduli (E1c 42.8, E2c 16.0). Yt = first-crack knee; S12 at 5% strain. E2 high due to ~6% transverse backing strands. t = 6-ply laminate / 6.
#  L035 Materials 2021 (PMC7914699) Table 4, U-E-600-1200 fabric, hand lay-up, Vf 60%, ISO 527-4 / 14126 / 14129. t = fabric thickness from Table 2.
#  L036 Plappert et al. 2020 Table 2, Vf 60%, ASTM D3039 / ISO 14126 / ISO 14129; tensile moduli (E1c 46.2, E2c 15.2). S12 at 5% strain. t* = 300 g/m2 / (2.75 g/cm3 x 0.60), basalt density assumed.
#  L037 Liang et al. (LAMPA Angers): stiffness from Liang 2015 (via IJIE 2015 Table 1), Xt/Yt from Int J Fatigue 2014 Table 1; Vf 43.1%. nu12 = 0.43 high (typical of flax). t* = 2.55 mm / 12 plies. Xc, Yc, S12 not reported.
#
# Usability (see check output of lamina_catalog_to_SI.py):
#   PlyPropertyGenerator needs E1, E2, G12, nu12 (+ nu23).  In-plane Tsai-Hill needs Xt, Xc, Yt, Yc, S12.
#   Both (25): L001-L009 L013-L022 L024 L026 L028 L034-L036
#   Stiffness only (3): L023 L027 L037      Strength only, nu12 or G12 missing (4): L010 L011 L012 L025
#   Partial (5): L029-L033 (nu12 missing, and Yc or Yt missing)
#   G23 not equal to E2/(2(1+nu23)) as given by the source: L009, L016 (small), L022 (suspect), L034.
#
